name: CRONUS
subtitle: THE GILDED HARVESTER
fantasy: The cunning youngest Titan raises an adamant sickle and gathers the sky into one impossible harvest.

organs.name: FATE EYE
organs.effect: The sickle stars lose their lock and fly in readable straight arcs.

organs.name: GAIA BREATH
organs.effect: The harvest rings slow down and their safe opening grows wider.

organs.name: ADAMANT FORGE
organs.effect: The golden sickle vents seal and stop launching blade shards.

name: HYPERION
subtitle: LORD OF FIRST LIGHT
fantasy: The Titan father of Sun, Moon and Dawn bends the first light into playful but punishing patterns.

organs.name: DAWN MIND
organs.effect: Dawn lances lose one reflected ray and shine a longer warning.

organs.name: SOLAR MANTLE
organs.effect: One sun-ray mantle folds away and leaves a permanent safe flank.

organs.name: SUN CROWN
organs.effect: The sun crown fractures and its radiant barrier can no longer close completely.

name: OCEANUS
subtitle: THE WORLDSTREAM
fantasy: The calm Titan of the earth-encircling river turns the sky into a rolling current of tides and storms.

organs.name: WORLDSTREAM HEART
organs.effect: The tide pull weakens and leaves a broad calm channel through every wave.

organs.name: STORM PALM
organs.effect: Storm arcs stop chaining through nearby tide markers.

organs.name: RIVER SPRINGS
organs.effect: The river springs close and no new wave sprites can join the battle.

name: MNEMOSYNE
subtitle: MOTHER OF ECHOES
fantasy: The Titaness of memory, words and language remembers every move and turns the Diver's own story into a final test.

organs.name: MEMORY CROWN
organs.effect: Mnemosyne forgets the equipped weapon and stops copying its shots.

organs.name: ECHO HEART
organs.effect: Echo paths fade; Mnemosyne can no longer replay the last dash.

organs.name: MUSE VEIL
organs.effect: False verses vanish and the true divine weak point stays visible.
